summary: Align social protection priorities, budgets and results in a five-day planning course. Explore the outline and see if it fits your role.
lede: Integrating social protection into national development plans means linking coverage and benefit priorities to development targets, financing and accountability. This training is for development planning officers, social protection specialists and public finance analysts who need to make those links clear in plan documents. Participants assess plan alignment, map institutional responsibilities, build an indicative MTEF costing table and define indicators and review arrangements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect social protection priorities with development-plan commitments, public budgets and government review processes.
modules: Theory of Change and Results Chains
prerequisites: This intermediate course suits you if you have working knowledge of social protection programmes or development planning. You do not need programming skills. Bring a laptop with Excel access for the costing exercise; no additional software installation or account is required.
